content.title: Teddi Mellencamp Hospitalized After Waking Up Covered in Sores Amid Cancer Battle
content.text: Teddy Mellencamp has been hospitalized after waking up covered in sores amidTeddi Mellencamp Hospitalized After Waking Up Covered in Sores Amid Cancer Battle0 seconds of 1 minute, 18 secondsVolume 0%Teddi Mellencamp Hospitalized After Waking Up Covered in Sores Amid Cancer BattleTeddi Mellencamp is recuperating after a scary illness. The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills star recently shared that she spent time in the hospital after contracting a rare and high-risk illness, Stevens-Johnson’s syndrome, which is a disorder of the skin and mucous membranes. “I hadn’t felt good for a couple days,” Teddi recalled to her friend and cohost Tamra Judge during the March 3 episode of Two Ts in a Pod. “I thought I had the flu and then I woke up one day and my whole body was just covered in this terrible rash—you can’t even say it’s a rash because they’re almost like sores, like, all over my entire body.” Teddi, who added that the sores“hurt and burned” kept calm amid the alarming situation and went to urgent care, thinking it would have an easy fix. However, she was told by her doctor, “‘You need to go to the ER right now.’” “Essentially what happened was I was given a new medication and I was allergic to it,” she said of what caused the illness, which she explained is “a rare life-threatening medical emergency causing severe, painful blisters of the skin and mucous membranes.”Indeed, the condition went beyond the surface of her skin, with Teddi—who shares Slate, 12, Cruz, 11, and Dove, 6, with ex Edwin Arroyave—noting, “It was everywhere.” “It went into my mouth,” she recalled. “Around my eyes a little bit. I couldn’t swallow.” And while the doctors at the hospital were able to quickly diagnose and address her illness, Teddi had to be admitted into the hospital. “They immediately started me on steroids and antibiotics and then after a couple days, it thankfully got better,” she recalled. “The reason they were like ‘You need to stay in,’ is that it can start to get better and then shift right back up."Maya Dehlin Spach/FilmMagicLuckily, though, Teddi was able to get discharged to make it to her youngest’s birthday party, with her recalling, “I wasn’t feeling great but just the adrenaline from seeing her.” As she put it, “I was so happy.” For more stars who have shared insight into their cancer journeys, keep reading…Paul Archuleta/Getty ImagesColin EgglesfieldThe All My Children alum announced in January 2025 that he had been diagnosed with prostate cancer, his third cancer diagnosis throughout his life. Despite the devastating news, he announced (for the third time) in February 2025 he was cancer-free following successful surgery and treatments. “Remember, you’re not defined by any of your challenges," he wrote in his February 2025 Instagram update. "You’re grander than it all. I’m not my fear, my anxiousness or my scars but I embrace it all because the only way to transform it is to own it.”Taylor Hill/WireImageGerry TurnerThe former Golden Bachelor star shared in Dec. 2024 that he had been diagnosed with Waldenström's macroglobulinemia, a bone cancer.
